Title: Mask of 1000 faces vs thoughts betrayed.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Timothy M Dolan Jr <tdol...@ix.netcom.com> writes:

>1. If you play mask of 1000 faces to replace a minion in combat that has
>been affected by thoughts betrayed, is the replacing minion still
>affected by thoughts betrayed?

Mask cannot be played at this time, since it is not a combat card, and TB
must be played 'at the last instant' before combat. If one wants to mask,
it must be done before TB. If the TBer played to quickly, you may ask
him to pick up the TB so that you be allowed to Mask.

<Misc. questions deleted as they are impossible with the answer above>

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:



Combat (resulting from a blocked action) occurs after the action, not
as a part of it. This is the official way of the world.

> The only relevant issue here is that Mask is an action modifier,
> and FoM is a combat modifier. This decides when they can be played,
> and action modifiers cannot be played during combat - unless the card
> specifically says so.
>
> Gary

I'll go with the argument that mask is not a combat modifier and
therefore can't be played while combat is occurring. Therefore mask of
100 faces is not a viable counter to thoughts betrayed. I still believe
however, that combat is a continuation of the action. I would still like
to hear other viable counters to TB instead of just it's broken. If when
all possible counters have been fairly shot down we as a group can not
find a reasonable counter to it then maybe it is broken.

In hopes of finding a reasonable counter without rules changes - Tim
Dolan.

Messages.Author: Simon Richardson
Messages.Body:
In article <4dskko$o...@ixnews3.ix.netcom.com>, Timothy M Dolan Jr <tdol...@ix.netcom.com> wrote:
> Given that you can use Form of Mist (a combat card) to continue an action
> (unless the wording changed in V:tes version) It would seem to indicate

No, you play "Form of Mist" to *end* combat and continue the action. It is
a S:CE card. Combat ends before you continue the action.

There are other cards like this: "Majesty", "Earth Meld", and, in it's own odd
way, "Dawn Operation".

> that combat is part of the action and therefore you should be able to
> play Mask of 1000 faces in the middle of combat. May be I missed a ruling
> or something, but is not combat a part of the action. Granted it
> obviously was not a succsefull action.

Combat is an alternative to the action. The action ends and combat begins.
With some S:CE cards and others the combat ends and an action begins.

Simon
